title: Receiving-side routes
what: The axum router that serves the routes a provider hands messages to, behind a bearer token, over the receiver a consuming service supplies (client/src/inbound.rs).

title: Provider client
what: One client for every provider: a method for each provider route, one failure type, and the same patience rule that offers a request again only while nothing listened (client/src/provider_client.rs).

title: Patience window
what: How long a request whose connection was refused keeps being offered and how often, counted by the waits asked for rather than by a clock so a test never waits on the real one (client/src/patience.rs).
